content: Hey love, how was your day? I couldn't stop thinking about our plans together.
Hi! My day was alright, work was a bit stressful but nothing I can't handle. Thinking about you helps.
You always make me smile. I want so much for us to have a place where we can finally be together and relax, away from all the stress.
That sounds like a dream. I wish I could just fast-forward to that part of our life.
Funny you say that, because today I found the most incredible apartment, right by the park, with a balcony just like you wanted. It's perfect for us.
Seriously? That would be amazing. What's it like inside?
Huge windows, hardwood floors, and a kitchen that you'd love. The owner says there's a ton of interest, but they'd hold it for us if we put down a deposit tonight.
Wow, it sounds perfect. But I know sometimes things can be too good to be true.
I totally get your concern. That's why I spoke to the owner myself, they're legit, and I wouldn't let anything happen to us. You know I've handled property deals before.
That's reassuring. I just get nervous about sending money online.
You can trust me on this, sweetheart. I've done transfers like this a hundred times. The deposit is only $2,000, and it secures our future. I want this for us.
Okay, I want this too. How do I send it?
Perfect. The owner prefers Zelle for speed. Can you send $2,000 to michael.apartments@outlook.com? Let me know when you've done it, you're making me so happy.
Alright, I'll log into my bank. Should I write anything in the note section?
Just put 'apartment deposit' in the note. No worries, I'll handle the rest. You're truly incredible for trusting me.
Okay, I'm about to send it. I'm a little nervous still, but I trust you.
Thank you, darling. This is the last step before we have a home together. I promise you won't regret it.
Done. Sent. Please let me know as soon as you see it go through.
Got it! I'm confirming with the owner right now. You've made me so happy. I can't wait for us to start this new chapter.
